units.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
units.text: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
units.label: Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
units.text: 1. The employer’s representative (employer) must suspend a municipal servant from the municipal service position held (exclude them from performing official duties) in cases provided for by labour legislation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
units.text: 2. The employer’s representative (employer) may suspend a municipal servant from the municipal service position held (exclude them from performing official duties) while a conflict of interest is being resolved. The servant retains remuneration throughout the suspension.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) suspends a municipal servant from the municipal service position held (excludes them from performing official duties) for the entire period until circumstances attributable to the servant’s fault that gave grounds for the suspension (exclusion from official duties) have been eliminated.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
units.text: 4. During suspension from a municipal service position (exclusion from official duties), no remuneration is accrued to the municipal servant, except in cases provided for by federal laws and this Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 36

units.locator: Chapter 8. PERSONNEL WORK IN A MUNICIPAL ENTITY
units.text: Chapter 8. PERSONNEL WORK IN A MUNICIPAL ENTITY
units.label: Chapter 8. PERSONNEL WORK IN A MUNICIPAL ENTITY

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.label: Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: The priority areas for developing the municipal service workforce are:
units.label: Art. 37 · “The priority areas for developing the municipal service…”

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: 1) appointing highly qualified specialists to municipal service positions with due regard to their professional qualities and competence;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: 2) facilitating the career advancement of municipal servants;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: 3) training personnel for municipal service and providing additional professional education for municipal servants;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: 4) creating a personnel reserve and using it effectively;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: 5) assessment of municipal servants’ professional level and work results through assessment procedures and qualification examinations;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: 6) use of modern personnel selection technologies when citizens enter municipal service and of modern personnel management technologies during service;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
units.text: 7) introduction into personnel practice of a rule requiring that a municipal servant’s long and impeccable performance of official duties be taken into account when they are appointed to a higher position, awarded a class rank or rewarded.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: Personnel work in local self-government bodies includes:
units.label: Art. 38 · “Personnel work in local self-government bodies includes:”

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 1) developing the workforce to fill municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 2) preparing proposals for implementing municipal service legislation and submitting those proposals to the employer’s representative (employer);
units.label: Point 2 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 3) organizing the preparation of draft municipal legal acts connected with entry into and performance of municipal service, conclusion of an employment agreement (contract), appointment to a municipal service position, release from the municipal service position held, dismissal from municipal service and retirement, and preparing the corresponding documents;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 4) maintaining municipal servants’ employment record books, where available, compiling information on their employment activity during municipal service, and submitting that information according to the procedure established by Russian Federation legislation on individual (personalized) record-keeping in the compulsory pension insurance system for storage in the information resources of the Pension and Social Insurance Fund of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 5) maintaining municipal servants’ personal files;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 6) maintaining the register of municipal servants in the municipality;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 7) preparing and issuing municipal servants’ official identity cards;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 8) conducting competitions to fill vacant municipal service positions and including municipal servants in the personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 8 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 9) conducting assessment procedures and qualification examinations for municipal servants;
units.label: Point 9 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 10) organizing work with the personnel reserve and ensuring its effective use;
units.label: Point 10 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 11) organizing and conducting verification of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into municipal service and during the municipal servant’s period of service;
units.label: Point 11 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 11.1) arranging clearance of the prescribed form to information constituting a state secret;
units.label: Point 11.1 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 12) organising verification of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by municipal servants, and of compliance with municipal service restrictions established by federal legislation and this Law;
units.label: Point 12 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 13) advising municipal servants on legal and other matters of municipal service;
units.label: Point 13 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
units.text: 14) resolving other personnel matters determined by labour legislation and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 14 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service
units.text: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service
units.label: Art. 38.1

units.locator: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service
units.text: 1. To form a highly qualified municipal service workforce, local self-government bodies may organise citizens’ training for municipal service on a contractual basis in accordance with the education legislation of the Russian Federation, taking account of the provisions of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” and this Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 38.1

units.locator: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service
units.text: 2. A targeted education agreement involving an obligation subsequently to perform municipal service is concluded between a local self-government body and a citizen in accordance with the Regulations on the Procedure for Concluding such an Agreement between a Local Self-Government Body and a Citizen, approved by this Law (Appendix 6).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 38.1

units.locator: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant’s personal data means information needed by the employer’s representative (employer) in connection with the servant’s performance of duties in the municipal service position held and concerning that particular servant, including surname, first name, patronymic, day, month, year and place of birth, address, family, social and property status, education, occupation, income and other information.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant’s personal data shall be processed (obtained, stored, combined, transferred and otherwise used) in accordance with labour legislation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.label: Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: 1. A personal file is created for a municipal servant, containing documents connected with their entry into municipal service, performance of that service and dismissal from it.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: 2. If a municipal servant enters municipal service in a local self-government body of another municipal formation or enters state civil service, their personal file is transferred to the new place of service. Maintaining several personal files for the same municipal servant is prohibited.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: 3. A municipal servant’s personal file is maintained, stored and transferred in the procedure established for maintaining, storing and transferring state civil servants’ personal files.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: 4. Collecting information about a municipal servant’s political or religious affiliation or private life and entering it in their personal file are prohibited.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: 5. At a municipal servant’s request, all materials in their personal file are made available for inspection.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: 6. If the local self-government body in which the municipal servant held a municipal service position is dissolved, the personal file is transferred for safekeeping to the local self-government body to which the dissolved body’s functions have been transferred, or to its legal successor.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
units.text: 7. On a municipal servant’s dismissal, their personal file is kept in the archive of the local self-government body at the last place of municipal service. The file is retained for 10 years from the date of dismissal from municipal service.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 41. Register of municipal servants
units.text: Article 41. Register of municipal servants
units.label: Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Register of municipal servants
units.text: 1. A register of municipal servants is maintained in the municipal formation. The procedure for maintaining it is approved by a municipal legal act.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Register of municipal servants
units.text: 2. Information about municipal servants holding municipal service positions and about persons included in the personnel reserve for vacant municipal service positions is entered in the register of municipal servants.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Register of municipal servants
units.text: 3. A municipal servant dismissed from municipal service is removed from the register on the dismissal date. A person removed from the personnel reserve for vacant municipal service positions is removed from the register, except where that person is appointed to a municipal service position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Register of municipal servants
units.text: 4. If a municipal servant dies (is killed), or is recognized as missing or declared dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force, the servant is removed from the register of municipal servants on the day following death (being killed) or the entry into legal force of the court decision.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Register of municipal servants
units.text: 5. By agreement between a local self-government body and the authorised executive body of the City of Moscow, information about municipal servants is sent to that executive body for studying and analysing the local self-government body’s personnel composition and for forming the register of municipal servants of municipal service in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant’s additional professional education includes advanced training and professional retraining.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant undertakes additional professional education throughout the entire period of municipal service.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: 3. A municipal servant’s advanced training is undertaken as necessary, but at least once every five years.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: 4. A municipal servant’s additional professional education is provided by organisations delivering additional professional educational programmes.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: 5. A municipal servant’s additional professional education may take any form of study provided for by education legislation, with or without release from municipal service.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: 6. The employer’s representative (employer) determines the type, form and duration of additional professional education according to the group of municipal service positions to which the servant’s position belongs.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
units.text: 7. A municipal servant sent for additional professional education with release from municipal service retains the position held and remuneration throughout the training period.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service
units.text: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service
units.label: Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service
units.text: 1. A personnel reserve for vacant municipal service positions may be established in municipal formations in accordance with municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service
units.text: 2. A municipal servant meeting the qualification requirements for the relevant municipal position is included in the personnel reserve. A person who is not a municipal servant but meets those qualification requirements may also be included in the reserve.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 43
